new-york-hudson-valley-rides-shawangunk-.story: Leave the city behind and spend the day on roads with texture. A 503 km loop that starts and ends near Baldwin Harbor, about 9 h 08 of riding. On the way it passes Carmel Hamlet, near Kiryas Joel and Emerson Hill. The climbs: near Bradley Gardens, Scenic stretch in Eatontown and Ocean Grove.

sections.advice: Food stop near Kiryas Joel → Photo stop near Bradley Gardens rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.
Photo stop near Bradley Gardens → Emerson Hill can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Use Scenic stretch in Eatontown → Ocean Grove as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
